data.one_liner: Create nested routes, sync app state with browser URLs, and animate transitions.
data.what_it_does: GgRouter helps you define nested routes, popover routes, and fallback routes in Flutter. It synchronizes application state with the browser URI, handles query parameters, and supports route-specific animations.
use_when: You want easy nested routing and browser URL synchronization.
You need page-based hierarchical navigation with animations.
avoid_when: You prefer standard mainstream routing packages like go_router or auto_route.
You need complex third-party navigation architectures not supported by GgRouter.
strengths: Saves and restores route state as JSON.
weaknesses: Niche package with limited community compared to go_router.
data.setup_notes: Provide GgRouterDelegate and GgRouteInformationParser to MaterialApp.router.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the officially endorsed declarative routing package for Flutter with a massive community.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: It offers strongly-typed route generation and deep linking out of the box.

alternatives.name: beamer
alternatives.why_pick_it: It specializes in routing delegate management and synchronizing state with the browser history.
